wind.source: No atmosphere (exosphere only), hence no wind

earth_limits.label: Gravity
earth_limits.effect: Mobility, anchoring, drilling and dust behave differently: no Earth site reproduces lunar gravity (about one sixth).

earth_limits.label: Oxygen and atmosphere
earth_limits.moon: no breathable atmosphere: no free oxygen, no pressure
earth_limits.earth: 21% oxygen in air at about 1 bar
earth_limits.effect: On Earth, engines, fire, sound, air cooling and breathing all work; on the Moon every system must bring its own oxygen and reject heat by radiation.

earth_limits.label: Vacuum
earth_limits.effect: No convection, no wind, no erosion by air: wind, humidity and precipitation criteria are proxies for a dry, calm environment.

earth_limits.label: Radiation
earth_limits.moon: no atmosphere and no global magnetic field: surface exposed to cosmic rays and solar particles
earth_limits.effect: No Earth site reproduces the lunar radiation environment.

earth_limits.label: Extreme cold
earth_limits.moon: 29 to 50 K in permanently shadowed regions (Diviner)
earth_limits.earth: about -90 °C (≈ 180 K) at the coldest, in Antarctica
earth_limits.effect: Temperature criteria are trend proxies (cold, day-night swing), never absolute values.
earth_limits.source: Paige et al. 2010, Science 330:479; EPSC2013-386 (see docs/scenarios.md)

earth_limits.label: Regolith and geology
earth_limits.moon: highland crust (anorthosite) at the south pole, regolith unaltered by water or life
earth_limits.earth: soils altered by water, air and life
earth_limits.effect: Earth basalt stands in for rock mechanics; anorthosite (Mistastin, Labrador) is the closest rock twin.

quake_count.text: 28 shallow moonquakes recorded in 8 years by the Apollo seismometers; no continuous microseisms, hence a sensitivity 100 to 1,000 times that of Earth
quake_count.source: Nakamura, NTRS 19930008250; Latham et al., NTRS 19780005006

lst_amplitude.text: at the equator, about 400 K at noon and under 100 K at night (swing of about 300 K); no Earth site comes close to this swing
